Agent 10/35 — combined-slip friction allocation during trail braking. At 50/70/100 km/h, sweep brake pressure and steering through corner entry. Measure front/rear kappa, alpha, Fx/Fy, utilization, yaw and stopping/turning response. Audit the combined-slip weighting/superellipse for unrealistic loss or surplus of lateral force. No fake assists or validation-only overrides. If changing tire math, preserve pure-slip curves and add mirrored combined-slip tests plus strict M5 validation.
